name: DFW 1980 to 2000 two-story on slab
description: Pre-code production housing of the 1980s and 1990s: two stories, slab, vented attic, brick front with siding, double-pane clear windows, attic flex ducts. Still no statewide code; builder practice tracked lender and utility programs. Every value is an estimate to seed the questionnaire; inspect and override.

era.code_basis: No statewide energy code in Texas before 2001 (SECO); builder practice.

style.typical_cladding: brick veneer front, siding sides and rear

sources.citation: RhoeFlow plan v2, Era-based defaults for DFW table (claude/01-plan/research-and-plan.md); estimates to seed the questionnaire
Texas SECO, single-family energy code history: no statewide code before 2001

ceiling_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Low end of the 1980 to 2000 range (6 in batts or equivalent blown). Replace with the measured depth.

wall_insulation_cavity_r.basis: 2x4 walls with R-11 batts were standard; R-13 appears late in the era.

window_ufactor.basis: Double-pane clear, aluminum or early vinyl frames; midpoint of the plan range.

window_shgc.basis: Double clear glazing; midpoint of the plan range.

air_leakage.basis: Midpoint of the plan range. A blower-door result replaces this.

duct_insulation_r.basis: R-4.2 flex duct was the common product; R-6 appears late in the era. Read the jacket label.

duct_leakage_to_outside.basis: Plan table gives roughly 15% for this era, read as total supply plus return to outside. A duct-blaster result replaces this.
